title: A Toast to Partings and Meetings, A Vintage Divine

text_block_list.text:
As summer training camp entered its final stretch,
Tanino Gimlet completed her daily routine without a hitch.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: ...I am satiated.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
A missing fragment of the page hath fallen perfectly into place.
I shall take my leave for the day.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
I do not, yet one shall surely present itself soon.
Within the realm of the extraordinary lie countless encounters, partings, and fleeting instants.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
I go forth to seek them. For chasing the light that vanishes in the blink of an eye
is the solemn duty of I, Gimlet. —Pardon me.
With that, she turned and departed.

What she pursues is the "fleeting moment."
That remained unchanged, even during summer camp.

I didn't have any particular plans either,
so I decided to take a stroll nearby for a little break.

text_block_list.name: Sun-Kissed Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
—Oh yeah! I heard the beach in the back is a real hidden gem!
The view is gorgeous, and the sunrise is supposedly out of this world!

text_block_list.name: Summer-Loving Horsegirl
text_block_list.text: Whoa, that sounds amazing...! If I can wake up early, I'd love to check it out!

I'd never had any reason to visit, so I'd never been.
Since I have some free time, now seems like the perfect chance.
choice_data_list: (All right, let's go take a look!)

text_block_list.text: After walking for a few minutes, the place I arrive at is—

A hill overlooking the open sea. The lush greenery framing the landscape
makes it look even more vivid than the main beach.

There's also a path nearby leading down to the shore. Just as those girls
were saying, you must get a crystal-clear view of the sun rising from the horizon—
...Or so I thought, until a certain memory struck me.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
That which scatters in a fleeting flash, shines, and is born anew.
That which sears into the soul, leaving one yearning in reverence.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
—That is precisely what I seek.
I act to attain that pinnacle. Thus, I run.

Right...! From here, she'd surely be able to witness it.
That fleeting, ephemeral instant when the sun breaks over the horizon—!

Without hesitation, I typed out a message to Tanino Gimlet,
attaching the location pins for this spot.
Soon the sun went down, and the night deepened—
—And then, the following morning.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: ...Quite unusual. For you to summon me.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
A convergence of hues worthy of a canvas, yet...
Did you yearn to intoxicate yourself with fine spirits amid the contrast?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
If so, I shall serve. As you well know,
it is your solemn duty to be intoxicated by me. Now, what do you desire?

Tanino Gimlet seems ready to serve me a drink,
but that isn't why I called her out here.
choice_data_list: That's not quite why I called you.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
choice_data_list: Could you look out toward the sea?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Very well. If such is the extent of your wish.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: ...Hm? That is—

Tanino Gimlet turns her gaze toward the ocean.
At that exact moment—a crimson dawn emerges from the horizon.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: ...The break of dawn—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: ......Heh, haha—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
HA HA HA!! AHAHAHA!!!!
AAAHHHHH-HA-HA-HA-HA-HA!!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: What a magnificent—DAWN!!!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
An instantaneous, fleeting genesis, an ephemeral phenomenon!!!!
A spectacle that sears intensely into the soul, never to be forgotten—!!!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
AAAHHHHH-HA-HA-HA-HA-HA!!!!!!
You have astounded me, Trainer, truly astounded me!!!!!!
choice_data_list: I take it you liked it?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Indeed!! Truly!! Most profoundly, yes!!!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
You have bestowed upon me an entirely new perspective!!!!
Striking, intense, just like the rising sun itself!!!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
I may intoxicate you—yet that alone is not the end of it!!
You too can deliver the fruits of intoxication, is that it?!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
What splendid fortune!! When one gazes into the abyss,
the abyss also gazes back into thee—truly!!!!

I didn't think I did anything quite that grand,
but seeing her this thrilled makes it all worthwhile.
choice_data_list: (I'm glad we could see this view together.)

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Hmph... Heh, an exquisite sensation.

Even after some time has passed,
Tanino Gimlet continues to gaze at the horizon in deep satisfaction.
choice_data_list: I didn't expect you to be this happy about it.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: ...It is only natural that I should rejoice.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
You know this already. The path I tread is no royal road.
It is a rugged ascent so steep it could pierce even the morning star.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
And yet... you stepped forward as my guide.
Such resolve is nothing less than the light illuminating purgatory itself.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
You have my gratitude.
My Virgil—or perhaps, my Beatrice.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, I may presume...
you shall continue to illuminate my path ahead, yes?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
A magnificent answer. If that is so, I shall remain ever ready
to pour the finest elixir for you at a moment's notice.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Once more—starting with a single drop of lime.
I shall serve it for your sake, and for the sake of our destiny.
